question.text:
The height $H$ metres of an object is modelled as a quadratic function of horizontal distance $x$ metres.
The model has a maximum when $x=80$, gives $H=18$ when $x=0$, and gives $H=48$ when $x=100$.

(a) Find a complete equation for the quadratic model.

(b) Hence state the maximum height and find the positive value of $x$ at which the model first predicts $H=0$.

(c) State one limitation of using this quadratic model for a real trajectory.
